newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Moscow police on alert for army deserter.
newsitem.headline: Moscow police on alert for army deserter.

text.p: Moscow police went on high alert on Sunday to search for an army deserter who was reported to have shot a man dead.

A police spokesman said a soldier armed with a Kalashnikov assault rifle, who had escaped from his barracks in the Russian capital on Saturday night, had wounded a pensioner and was hiding somewhere in town.

Police, who were stopping cars and checking drivers' documents in central Moscow, could not confirm a report by Interfax news agency that the deserter had also shot dead a man walking his dog in a city park.
